title: Southport High School: A New Exhibit
html:
Join us for a special evening celebrating the history of Southport High School and the future opening of a new exhibit at the Fort Johnston Southport Museum — devoted to the school and the generations of students, teachers, and families who were part of its story. Through historic photographs, stories, and memorabilia, the exhibit will bring back memories of school days at Southport High School and help preserve this important part of our community's history for future generations.

Did you attend Southport High School? We especially hope you'll join us — and bring along photographs, yearbooks, or other school memories to share during the evening.

When: Thursday, November 5, 6:30 PM
Where: Southport Community Building, 223 E Bay St
Cost: Free — reservations required; seating is limited
Registration: Public registration is now open.
Door prize: Two tickets to the 2026 Holiday Tour of Homes on Saturday, December 12

Registration required

title: New! The SHS Brick Finder Is Here
html:
Our brand-new Brick Finder tool is live. Search and browse the commemorative bricks at historic Fort Johnston, find exactly where your brick is located, and add photos and stories to your brick’s page — all in one place. Ordering a brick? You can do that right in the tool, too.

Cost: 4×8 brick $100 (3 lines of text); 8×8 brick $150 (6 lines).

Orders: Open October 1 through November 30 — honor a loved one, commemorate an event, or preserve something meaningful to you and support SHS today.

title: Family Tree Help at the Harper Library

Where: Harper Library Computer Room.
